target: Palm OS colour retail build via emulation - all 15 levels, 35 sublevels, every sublevel enemy tally, six weapons, eight enemy families, and one completed-run score

areas.name: Hatshepsut

areas.note: This level contains 3 fixed sublevels; the enemy tally resets for each one.

save_backup.title: Keep a state before each sublevel exit
save_backup.why: A transition can close the corridors behind it while the previous enemy counter is still incomplete.

items.label: Verify the Palm Controls and NETRICSA

levels.1: Spend a moment learning the hardware-button layout before committing to the maze.
levels.2: Test movement, turning, strafing, firing, weapon selection, and the information screen in the opening rooms.
levels.3: Use Date Book and Address Book to turn; use the scroll control to move; hold Memo Pad while turning to strafe; fire with To-Do; tap the Graffiti area to cycle weapons; and press Find to open NETRICSA. Confirm each input works before advancing.

levels.1: Keep mapping each junction until the current maze has no untested exit.
levels.2: Finish all 3 sublevels shown by the current-sublevel display.
levels.3: Clear Hatshepsut from sublevel 1 through sublevel 3. At every junction, finish side passages before using the route that advances the sublevel; after the final transition, confirm the next named level appears.

levels.1: Listen for unfinished encounters before leaving each part of the maze.
levels.2: Before advancing each of the 3 sublevels, compare the defeated-enemy value with its displayed total.
levels.3: Open the status view before every sublevel exit and require “Sublevel enemies killed” to show the full displayed amount. If it is short, retrace all branch corridors and rooms; do not cross the one-way transition until the two values match.

items.label: Complete the Six-Weapon Register

levels.1: Use every unfamiliar weapon before the last level closes.
levels.2: Open NETRICSA and reconcile its weapon records before the final transition.
levels.3: Confirm records for all six weapons: Schofield .45, 12 Gauge Pump-Action Shotgun, M1-A2 Thompson Submachine Gun, XM214-A Minigun, XPML21 Rocket Launcher, XL2 Lasergun. If one is absent, return to the latest retained checkpoint before the missing pickup, collect it, and fire it once so its entry is registered.

items.notes_internal: Exact first-pickup placement is not reliably established; no location is invented.

items.label: Complete the Eight-Enemy Register

levels.1: Check that every unfamiliar creature has appeared in the information screen.
levels.2: Reconcile NETRICSA's enemy list before leaving the final map.
levels.3: Reconcile the register in pairs: Arachnoid with Gnaar; Kleer Skeleton with Scythian Witch-Harpy; Minor Bio-mechanoid with Beheaded Firecracker; and Beheaded Kamikaze with Beheaded Rocketeer. For an absent record, restore an earlier checkpoint and keep that creature in view until NETRICSA updates.

items.notes_internal: Exact first-encounter placement is not reliably established; no location is invented.

levels.1: Keep one result from the fully cleared run.
levels.2: After the last level, preserve the score produced by the enemy-complete route.
levels.3: Enter a high-score record after completing every level and every sublevel enemy counter, then capture or write down that total. The score system has no finite completion ceiling, so one verified full-run result completes this check without endless grinding.
